summary.intent: Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by investigating the load test and API endpoint validation flow.
summary.outcome: Discovered two root causes: (1) no API endpoint existed to enable BYO mode on accounts, so register-cid always returned 403; (2) the load test's ipns-publish call sent wrong fields. Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint, fixed load test to enable BYO mode and use sdk-core's createAndPublishIpnsRecord. Also fixed widespread pre-existing TypeScript errors in API spec files caused by jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> losing mock types after module.get().

repo: setByoStatus() exists in VaultService but was dead code — no controller endpoint wired it up, meaning BYO mode could never be enabled via the API.
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES is duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — now centralized in packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts.
The tee-worker was moved from /tee-worker to /apps/tee-worker in the Phase 35 merge.
All roadmap phases are completed as of the Phase 35 Phala testnet TEE migration merge.
The API's OpenAPI spec generation requires the API server to be running; orval can be run separately once the spec is generated.
The load test's byo-file-workload.ts was calling the IPNS publish endpoint with {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires {ipnsName, record (base64 signed IPNS record), metadataCid}.
A stale pending todo copy was merged into main alongside the done copy — the merge of fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 included both the pending/ and done/ versions of the SDK GCM todo.

code.finding: New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added to expose VaultService.setByoStatus().
createByoClientPool never called the BYO status endpoint — accounts were never put in BYO mode, causing all register-cid calls to return 403.
ipns-publish step sent wrong DTO fields ({ipnsName, cid} instead of {ipnsName, record, metadataCid}). Fixed to use sdk-core's createAndPublishIpnsRecord.
jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> loses mock method types after module.get() — fixed by using mock object directly instead of re-fetching from module.
New centralized module for STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD, selectEncryptionMode(), and normalizeEncryptionMode().

workflow: When jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> is used, always reference the original mock variable directly rather than re-fetching via module.get() — the re-fetched value loses mock typings.
The /gsd:check-todos workflow shows stale pending copies when a PR merges both pending/ and done/ versions of a todo — need to manually clean up duplicate pending entries after pulls.
SDK test files that vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core') with a bare factory need to spread importOriginal to avoid breaking when new exports are added.
GitHub GraphQL API for review threads can time out; fall back to REST (gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments) to fetch PR review comments.

friction: GraphQL API for fetching review threads timed out; had to fall back to REST endpoint.
API client regeneration (api:generate) failed due to unrelated Rust lint errors in the monorepo lint step — had to run orval directly.

Pre-existing TypeScript errors in 7+ API spec files (republish, shares, tee, vault) caused by the jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern — these were spread across multiple files and required significant remediation time.
The sdk-core build output needed to be rebuilt before sdk typecheck could pass — stale compiled types caused false type errors.
The todo for 'SDK uploadFile hardcodes GCM' appeared in both pending/ and done/ after the Phase 35 merge, requiring manual cleanup.
open_items: The new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint lacks an E2E test — only unit-level coverage via the controller spec.
integration.test.ts in the SDK package fails due to hitting a real API endpoint — pre-existing issue, not addressed.
The load test's ipns-publish step now uses createAndPublishIpnsRecord but hasn't been validated against staging to confirm the 400 errors are resolved.
FLAC streaming support was added reactively — worth auditing other lossless formats (AIFF, ALAC, WAV) to confirm they're correctly excluded from CTR mode.

The ipns-publish DTO mismatch (sending {ipnsName, cid} instead of {record, metadataCid}) suggests the load test may have never successfully exercised the IPNS publish path — staging baseline metrics for this step are likely invalid.
